decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=0x04, dst=/sensor/temp, src=/reply-ep } — opcode 4, the first value RFC-0004 §B leaves undefined. The op byte's bits 7-6 are reserved and MUST be zero, so this byte names no operation; the terminus answers ERROR{tr::schema::type_mismatch} (0x0030) along src.
decoded.note: Not a reject.bin case: the frame decodes, and a forwarder masks the op byte (op & 0x3F) and routes it on unchanged. The refusal is the terminus's. See description.md.
